production.note: US model years. First: PCNA's release is titled 'The new 2019 Cayenne Turbo' and says it is 'Expected to arrive at dealerships in Fall 2018'. Last: KBB's 2023 Cayenne lineup still lists 'Turbo Sport Utility 4D' at 541 hp (kbb-cayenne-2023); its 2024 lineup has no plain Turbo (kbb-cayenne-2024), and PCNA's 2024 release says the 'Turbo E-Hybrid model replaces previous Turbo variant' (pcna-2024-cayenne-turbo-e-hybrid). The Cayenne Turbo Coupe (same engine) is covered by this record.

body.note: Five-door SUV; the later Cayenne Turbo Coupe is also an SUV body.

displacementL.note: 3,996 cc (Porsche AG technical data: 'Displacement 3,996 cm³'). Porsche's US sheet gives '4.0' L.

aspiration.note: 'Twin-turbo V8'; PCNA: 'The turbochargers are arranged inside the cylinder V'

powerHp.note: Quote (US 2019 Cayenne technical data, columns Cayenne | Cayenne E-Hybrid | Cayenne S | Cayenne Turbo): "335 @ 5,300 - 6,400 | 335 @ 5,300 - 6,400 | 434 @ 5,700-6,600 | 541 @ 5,750-6,000". PCNA release: "4.0L twin-turbo V8 makes 541 hp, 567 lb-ft of torque". Porsche AG: 404 kW (550 PS). KBB's 2023 listing still gives 541 hp.

weightLb.note: US curb weight, 2019 Cayenne Turbo SUV, standard 8-speed Tiptronic S. Quote: "Curb Weight (lbs): 4377 | 5060 | 4454 | 4795" (Turbo is the fourth column). Porsche AG's MY 2021 sheet gives 'Unladen weight (DIN) 2,175 kg' (porsche-ag-cayenne-turbo-td-2021), which is the same 4,795 lb.
